objective: Limited new bridge budget reduces the interval based on actual historical observations; compare point-estimate difference and interval-based effect-direction conclusions with a high-budget direct reference.
history_selection: numpy default_rng(SeedSequence([history_selection_seed,design_id])).permutation(12)[:4]; one actual independent observation each; no outcome-based selection
history_cost_accounting: 4 pre-existing study-effect observations reported separately; identical history available to every method
candidate_types: all original 12; fresh independent repetitions allowed, including types observed in history
standardization: Student-t5 * sqrt(3/5); beta=Cholesky(original prior) z; noise=original sigma*standardized_t5
direction_rule: positive iff interval lower > 0; negative iff interval upper < 0; otherwise uncertain
reference_shared_inputs: same beta and actual historical Y as all methods; no additional future-noise sharing
reference_interpretation: high-budget direct reference, not ground truth; no conditional posterior guarantee
stopping: none before the fixed maximum 8 for policies and 64 for reference; all budgets scored from actual observations
cost_unit: one independent study-level effect observation; no participant/currency conversion
coverage_scope: pointwise joint marginal over beta and history plus new noises for design-only weights/paths; not conditional on history or a simultaneous path guarantee

pre_run_estimate.basis: preceding 40000-world run took 180.3s with many more path states; revise using smoke throughput before full

report_requirements: all 200 designs and all frozen budgets, no selection by results
actual historical estimates and intervals; all source weights
width change from history; same-budget comparisons
point-estimate difference to reference and fraction <= .30
same decisive sign divided by all worlds; reference-decisive decomposition
reference own uncertainty and true error retained
fully auditable sufficient statistics, source hashes, code revision, runtime and a prespecified world trace
read all reviewer concerns before and after; no automatic resolved status
